snippet.title: Our First Florida Hurricane Was a DIRECT HIT! | Hurricane Isaias 2026
snippet.description:
When we moved to Florida, everyone told us we'd eventually experience a hurricane. We just never expected our first one to be this intense.

As Hurricane Isaias approached, forecasts were calling for up to 9 feet of storm surge, and our home sits directly on the water. We spent days preparing, watching every forecast, wondering if the bay would end up inside our house.

Thankfully, we ended up on the west side of the eye, which pushed the worst storm surge farther east of us. The winds were incredible, the rain was relentless, and it was an experience our family will never forget.

Most importantly, everyone stayed safe, and the damage to our home was surprisingly minimal. We know many others weren't as fortunate, and our thoughts and prayers are with every family affected by the storm.

This isn't a fishing video...

It's a look at what it's really like to experience your first Florida hurricane from the front row.

snippet.title: Evacuation order for BC’s Loon Lake extends to nearly 1,500 properties due to Pear Lake fire
snippet.description:
Hundreds more B.C. residents are under an evacuation order in the South Cariboo region as the Pear Lake fire continues to grow.

The Thompson-Nicola Regional District expanded the evacuation order on Friday morning for the Loon Lake and South Green Lake area, adding approximately 375 properties to the 1,119 already on evacuation order.
The Pear Lake fire is now estimated at 73,217.11 hectares.

Taya Fast reports on the efforts to contain the fast-growing fire.
